cognium_conformis.latest_main_difference: This is `main` on 2026-11-09 (`d4eb53a`), 217 commits after the 2026-11-02 run's revision `7fa92329`.

rerun.title: Accessibility benchmark: Cognium Conformis at main on the latest browser-served lane
rerun.purpose: This bundle runs Cognium Conformis at `main` (`d4eb53a`) on the same 214 pages, corpus revision and subject declaration as `2026-11-02-rerun-v0.1.0-latest-browser-served-conformis-main`. The product revision, pack versions, browser build and container execution differ from that run; those differences are listed under the environment. No other product was run. The same evening's re-run of the six direct tools matched the 2026-11-02 six-tool columns on every case and is not republished.
rerun.comparison_note: Six more known-defect cases are detected and two fewer declared criteria match. Every corrected control stayed target-clean. `AX-05/4.1.2` no longer fires: nine pages stay detected on 2.1.1, and `patterns-accordion` loses its only declared match.

difference_notes.cognium: Seven known-defect cases gain a declared criterion: `static-input_purpose_missing` (1.3.5, `AX-14/1.3.5-missing`), `patterns-breadcrumb` (1.3.1, `AX-06/1.3.1-breadcrumb`), `patterns-media-captions` (1.2.2 and 1.2.3, `AX-13`), `media-video_no_captions` (1.2.2, `AX-13/1.2.2`), `journey-signin-broken` (3.3.8, `AX-20/3.3.8`), `scenario-dragging_required` (2.5.7, `AX-23/2.5.7`) and `scenario-pointer_cancellation` (2.5.2, `AX-28/2.5.2`). Nine pages lose 4.1.2 (`AX-05/4.1.2`) and remain detected on 2.1.1: the div button, text field and checkbox, and the disclosure, dialog, combobox, menu, switch and listbox. `patterns-accordion` goes from a 4.1.2 detection to an undeclared finding. Several other cells move from no finding to an undeclared finding; none of those is a declared criterion of a corrected control.

reference_scorer.note: The reference scorer of the pinned corpus revision (`check/score.mjs` at `469486a4`, policy `cognium-a11y-scoring/1.0.0`, `--strict`) applied to this bundle's `result.json`. For `7fa92329` it gives 84/207 (40.6%), 84/189 (44.4%) and 0/192.

environment_differences: Linux x86_64 on the same class of host, with Chromium 149.0.7827.55 (Playwright 1.61.1) instead of Chromium 153.0.8010.12.

Browser passes ran in `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble@sha256:5b8f294aff9041b7191c34a4bab3ac270157a28774d4b0660e9743297b697e48`. The 2026-11-02 main run used a local stand-in for docker and the host fonts. This run's recorded fonts are the image fonts (WenQuanYi Zen Hei and Liberation Sans).
The corpus server listened on 0.0.0.0:4173 so the container could reach it as host.docker.internal. The subject origin stayed http://127.0.0.1:4173.
Conformis at `d4eb53a` uses browser driver 0.28.1 and static-html driver 0.4.1 (0.26.1 and 0.3.0 at `7fa92329`), and packs `a11y/html@1.8.0` and `tech/html-aria@1.4.0`.
This scan ran alone, after the six direct tools had finished. It did not pass `--explore`, `--bench-run` or `--axe-cross-check`.
limits: One repetition. The difference from `7fa92329` is two single runs, and the browser build, fonts and container execution are not held fixed.
`a11y/html@1.8.0` and `tech/html-aria@1.4.0` are workspace versions at `d4eb53a`, not published registry versions; the commit is the pin. The repository is private.
This bundle keeps the 2026-10-13 corpus revision. Later corpus revisions changed some assertions, and results against them are not comparable with this one.
No flows or state drivers were declared: the lane measures loaded entry pages. The inventory probe does not click on this live run unless `--bench-run` is passed, and it was not.
